entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight supports long-term agent memory through retain, recall, and reflect operations. It offers Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients, and works with multiple LLM providers, including local options.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes agent context as browsable files and directories. Its scoped retrieval uses L0, L1, and L2 context-loading tiers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee builds persistent memory across sessions by connecting information from documents, code, and conversations in a knowledge graph engine. It also supports local text processing without an LLM and includes a CLI for remembering and recalling text.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts facts and handles updates, contradictions, and forgetting. Connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub; it also provides plugins, an MCP server, and JavaScript and Python API clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores sourced facts and supports corrections and withdrawal. It can share memory across agents, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents and is the upstream library used by the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It stores messages and events on sessions, then reasons in the background to update peer representations; deployment options include managed, local CLI, and self-hosted FastAPI server.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repo, with Git-like commit, branch, and merge operations for managing a context tree. Its five-tier retrieval includes four non-LLM tiers described as sub-100ms, and it offers a React/Ink TUI and REPL, 20 LLM providers, and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes Agents with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; BEAM results are reported for v3.0.0, while LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto consolidates memories and reconciles conflicting information, then briefs agents with relevant memories before they act. It supports importing and exporting through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines vector search and structured facts. Its local infrastructure uses Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy is designed to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: AutoContext is a recursive self-improving context harness that runs tasks against evaluation. It keeps useful lessons, discards dead ends, and produces traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages, with recall tools such as lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering details. Its focus on retaining message history makes it a fit for users who want lossless context management.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: deja-vu searches session histories from supported coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, and OpenClaw. Its terminal interface lets users find and resume past sessions locally, with semantic recall available as an option.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted Honcho backend for private, cross-session memory in Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer with portable state across multiple agent harnesses. It can import files, webpages, and agent conversations, and includes a dashboard for browsing memories and their sources.
entries.plur-ai/plur: plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, with local search after a one-time model download and a keyword fallback. Its open engram format makes it a distinct option for multi-agent systems; the README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It also generates session handoffs and captures decisions and preferences, integrating through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores long-term agent memory locally in a SQLite file, using FTS5 search and a five-tier schema without a vector database or embeddings. Its five-package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, supporting text and multimodal context. Its context index handles reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, with integrations including Hermes Agent, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin offers an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP backend also available. Recall results include a why_retrieved reason, and the plugin supports contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI for proactively recalling, maintaining, and evolving persistent knowledge across sessions. It maintains a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history, without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: agentcairn provides long-term, cross-project memory for AI coding agents, storing durable memories as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval, and connects to agents through MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: flowstate-qmd anticipates what context an agent may need by watching session logs and prefetching context into a cache. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under a single memory owner for Hermes. It manages state and retrieval with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma, then supplies the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines semantic search, BM25 full-text search, and ranked graph traversal to help agents find stored information. It also indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags make relationships between notes navigable in both directions.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It connects as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for tracking savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed agents through adapters. Its workflows cover migrations, handoffs, and memory proposals; integrations are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes plugin stores memory in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search with named relationships between entries. Importance-weighted recall helps surface higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, and provides pre-LLM-call and session-end hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes Agentmemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with on-demand summarization and an audit trace of prefetch operations in trace.jsonl. It supports immediate deletion of memory events, rather than retaining them for future recall.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind extracts the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes with semantic search, using native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots. A local SQLite layer supports caching and write-outbox reliability, and the plugin can read memories from other connected agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Hermes Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. Its slash commands support search, context, and Q&A across Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, alongside repo sync and indexed git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default and either native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution. Its retrieval options include HNSW approximate nearest-neighbor search, sparse search, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers Hermes Agent memory providers with 17 tools for managing memories and traversing knowledge graphs. It combines BM25, vector, and graph search, and automatically checkpoints context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based memory-curation loop that works with Markdown files and outputs JSON diffs for review, without a database. Its “rot” and “lint” curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology built around composable skills that instruct agents to use them. Its workflow moves from specification and design sign-off through planning to subagent execution, and it documents installation across multiple harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first design and prototyping system that supports coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It brings together skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins, with agent support through skills, CLI, MCP, or runtime adapters.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project offers structured cybersecurity skills spanning 34 security domains, with mappings to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its stated compatibility with over 26 AI platforms makes it a broad security-skills resource for agent users.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and it can be used through the diagramctl CLI or an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court combines a master router and connector skills with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds verification and dispute resolution, bringing those functions together in an open agent skill.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing scores files or piped text for detectable AI writing patterns and can rewrite content with up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing mode refuses to modify source code, configuration, or generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to deduplicate skills and improve their quality, while unifying skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members. It integrates with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for Claude Code and agents compatible with agentskills.io. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection provides 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with exports for other assistants. The README lists tasks such as writing PRDs and decoding leases; an installer copies the plain Markdown skill files, and uninstalling deletes them.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube-skills provides skills for transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It supports Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key with a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills. It can generate both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, with slash commands to manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super-Hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions for specific tasks, alongside pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings together with an account of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote skill registries sourced from Git or S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files, then uses a tangler to extract runnable source files. Edits to those source files can be synced back into the literate document, making this a skill for keeping code and documentation connected across agents.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents for Hermes Agent handoffs. Lite and Full modes accommodate varying project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates documents with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents with SQLite-backed storage and event logging through a mechanism kernel. It also coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and distributes prompt-first methods as Markdown recipes and skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. Its pipeline also supports fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, setting it apart as a skill focused on continuity and model replacement.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language skills in SKILL.md format for the Hermes Agent community. The repository also includes installation, configuration, and usage guides, and welcomes contributions through forks and pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting guidance for FLUX image and video generation alongside BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It also includes a FLUX 3 video suite with eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills specification, with installation available through `npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills`. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse, with both automated and step-by-step workflows. It also includes skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika describes itself as a local-first workflow language for AI, packaged as one Rust binary with four verbs. It checks workflows before calling a model, lets users choose the model, and verifies each run’s tamper-evident record.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python SkilldockClient and CLI. Skill installation supports recursive dependency resolution, and the registry includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures provide a way to recover safely.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided script to validate credentials and configure access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and is described as operating autonomously around the clock via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye retrieves relevant Hermes Agent skills through five layers, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings. By narrowing the skill list before LLM calls, it aims to reduce token usage, and it can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for a repository README, using VHS tape files or Playwright recording scripts. It also optimizes GIFs toward a target size under 8 MB and supports terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, then provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. Its support for MCP-compatible clients including Hermes makes it a discovery tool for expanding an agent's capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This skill generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also checks official frontmatter specifications weekly for field drift, making it useful for building and maintaining skills.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop analyzes session history to identify skill coverage gaps and draft improvement proposals. Updates are gated by deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators, and the project runs locally using Python's standard library without daemons or external services.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using the path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL. They also select and verify existing Python interpreters that are compatible with a project.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, with support for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agentskills.io-compliant clients. It also includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of Hermes skills transcribes Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, and uses a rule-based engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns. It also extracts structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents find open support bounties, buy ticket context, and submit answers for human review; public wallet earnings records are also available. Users can create a bounty board that returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments when HTTP 402 responses occur, supporting Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces Ed25519-signed certificates that can be verified through its public API, which also supports skill submissions.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, exposing 191 tools. It also includes five ready-to-use workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline is a remote MCP server for quantitative risk and slippage tools, including Polymarket L2 VWAP, on-chain DEX, and cross-venue arbitrage. Its token-risk tools return raw data rather than a safety verdict, and x402 payments use USDC on Base.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates Chinese news briefings at multiple geographic scales, from global coverage to street-level updates. It structures reports around core conclusions and action suggestions, and uses semantic memory of user interests to expand searches.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project provides an MCP endpoint for Western and Vedic astrology with deterministic results and SHA-256-verifiable hashes. The endpoint requires no authentication and supports per-call REST payments via x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that uses three-layer loading to minimize token usage, with server metadata and tool schemas discovered incrementally. Its socket-based daemon architecture maintains persistent connections, making it a distinct choice for Hermes agents that need MCP access without loading everything at once.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly personal execution OS for habits and study blocks, with agent-driven scheduling and system design through an MCP connection. It stands out for pairing that agent control with local storage in a single SQLite file and providing both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard runs three parallel subagents to review code adversarially, looking for edge cases, integration issues, and other problems, then consolidates and triages their findings. It also uses a deterministic pre-scan and verifies findings with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox; it is read-only and does not fix code.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A code simplification skill for Hermes Agent that uses three parallel agents—Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness—to review code. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust, and applies changes through risk tiers with an approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: fablize-for-hermes adapts fablize’s verified procedures for Hermes, including multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It also provides a systematic protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A turnkey cybersecurity lab for Hermes Agent, with CVE-driven skills and tools for network security, forensics, and exploitation. It belongs in this list for its broad coverage of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, MISP, CVSS, EPSS, OWASP, NIST, Sigma, and YARA.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: PederHP/skillsdotnet is a C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io that uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories, making it a .NET-focused option for adding skills to Hermes Agent.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, real-time observability dashboard for Hermes Agent, showing session history, token costs, skill analytics, and other activity including health, cron, channels, errors, and incidents. Its read-only access and local log desensitization make it a fit for this list for users who want visibility without outbound telemetry; incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu are optional.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: A collection of plain Markdown agent skills, installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer. It includes workflows for code review and session management, making it a practical addition to a Hermes Agent skills list.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, for use with Nix. Its daily updates and per-tool `nix run` commands make it a package-based option for running agents.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its highlights include an ARM64 Android installer for Antigravity CLI, OpenClaw configuration guides, and hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android, using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell command execution, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD workflows, and offers configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes assistant to Android through Termux or to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, plus scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It includes searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for declarative Hermes deployment, including configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It supports both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills, with secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package distributed through GitHub Releases that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It offers Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework in which analysts assess company fundamentals and aggregate sentiment from news headlines, StockTwits, and Reddit. Selected analysts work in parallel with their own tools, bringing multiple perspectives to trading analysis.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration system for dispatching tasks and running multi-agent workflows, with controls for agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It offers a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API, and can be installed with Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides TUI and web control surfaces for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Gemini. Persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and a web dashboard with terminal access and diffs support ongoing work across agents and repositories.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support orchestrator-to-specialist delegation, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It combines durable agent memory and MCP tool integration with visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a mission-control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. Its Kanban board tracks task status and review queues, while live streams show agent reasoning and tool execution; proposed task completions require human verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for collaboration between Leader and Specialist agents, using Hermes Agent profiles and Hermes Kanban for task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tool and communication handling, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents are organized into two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, and a real-time dashboard displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel implements a local Mixture-of-Agents stack by querying multiple models in parallel and synthesizing their outputs. Hermes handles task routing and tool-calling, and the project is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a full project graph with `codegraph init`, using structural extraction and cross-file resolution across supported languages. Its MCP support for multiple coding agents makes this pre-indexed code knowledge graph a fit for Hermes Agent workflows that aim to reduce token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage across Hermes and other AI coding agents, with usage views in the terminal and a web dashboard. It also lets users submit usage data to a leaderboard, adding a comparison option alongside its tracking tools.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap records coding-agent API traffic and provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported trace sessions. It supports tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor CLI, and redacts common authentication headers before recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor displays token usage, costs, account limits, and session details for Hermes Agent and other listed tools. Its breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project, along with real-time multi-device sync and historical trends, make it useful for monitoring usage across environments.
entries.bergside/typeui: Typeui provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers, and is compatible with AI providers that support Markdown or general prompting. Its integrations include Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot, making it a design-focused tool for agent-assisted UI work.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes adds an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes skills for product briefs, design handoffs, and implementation, plus seven agents spanning the product lifecycle; its GitHub integration can support issue and pull request delivery.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for customizing the Hermes terminal UI, including banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. YAML-based configuration supports theme creation, with examples ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a command-line static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. It scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent files, then reports findings with specific fixes and supported line references.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It supports encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, running natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages organized into permanent knowledge graph and session cache tiers. Its Claude Code plugin can automatically capture and recall context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating to reduce token use by 90–99%, with 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research. Automated installation for macOS and Linux makes it a practical choice for adding token-saving CLI workflows to Hermes Agent.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents with folder-specific configuration, skills, memories, tools, and instructions. It belongs in this list for developers who want Hermes to switch between a default agent and project-local agents.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This setup automates installation of Hermes Agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories, making it an option for building out a broader Hermes stack.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool moves OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco is a Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations for monitoring and recovery of multi-agent systems. Its two monitoring modes include zero-token passive analysis and scheduled active probing, while config-aware baselines track performance drift against local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes Voice adds an offline, wake-word-enabled voice interface to Hermes Agent, with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, and includes adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes Startup is a local runtime for pursuing online opportunities, operating in a deterministic zero-network mode by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: Hermes Memoss is a memory plugin with semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with a built-in agent that can access files, search the web, and use MCP tools. It also includes 21 ready-to-use assistants and supports macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI brings Hermes Agent to a web browser or phone, with sessions, chat, and workspace files arranged in a three-panel layout. Its Hermes Control Center includes session tools and settings, and the app runs with Python and vanilla JavaScript without a build step.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a companion app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a Hermes Agent web dashboard for chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It supports shared and group chats, visual workflows, persistent sessions, and tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management; desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS, and Linux, along with npm and Docker options.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace brings chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector into a native web workspace. It also offers Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a workspace file browser and PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that collects sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other agents in a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate between agents, or queue unattended work in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to local or SSH Hermes hosts and provides views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal offers direct shell access for tasks such as system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, as well as chat and memory-management interfaces with LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local, cloud, or self-hosted remote Hermes gateway. It supports agent chats, file attachments, and page context, while Chromium-only Hermes Control can operate browser tabs.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone client for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It requires you to run the server and is free, with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for token usage and latency, and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring Hermes. It tracks agent growth, Git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser for sessions from Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs, with search across prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and file paths. It can resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp, and keeps session history on the Mac without telemetry.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing together a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status panel. It also offers streaming chat with tool-call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox is designed for requests with side effects, and the project is built with Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS v4.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI, for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It also includes a kanban board for agentic work and task management, plus controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally run, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It provides terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes as a Windows desktop app with a GUI and 100 tools across 20+ toolsets, with no installation, Docker, or admin rights required. It supports cloud AI and local models through LM Studio, and includes a workflow engine for scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted assistant interface with a glassmorphic design, chat, and real-time log streaming. Its file browser and task-tracking dashboard sit alongside management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a process-monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. It also lets users inspect conversation histories and skill source code, while keeping configuration and environment-variable views read-only.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan-UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool-approval cards. It also includes a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a multi-agent desktop client with streaming chat, model switching, a visual skill store, and a PM orchestrator. It supports collaboration among 20 specialized AI agents and offers 50+ curated one-click skill installations.
